observation.command: cd /var/www/html/examples/basic; echo "=== jq validation of all JSON ==="; for f in config.json resources/services.json resources/rest-services.json resources/style_v3.json; do if command -v jq >/dev/null; then jq empty "$f" && echo "OK  $f"; else node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('$f','utf8'));console.log('OK  $f')" 2>&1; fi; done; echo; echo "=== config.js syntax check ==="; if command -v node >/dev/null; then node --check config.js && echo "config.js syntax OK"; else echo "node not available, skipping"; fi; echo; echo "=== config.js head ==="; head -40 config.js; echo; echo "=== config.json keys ==="; (jq -r 'keys[]' config.json 2>/dev/null || node -e "console.log(Object.keys(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('config.json','utf8'))))")
